embeds.title: Embed Studio
embeds.desc: Design and transmit advanced messages in server channels.
embeds.vars_info: You can use variables like {user} to personalize the message.
embeds.editor.url_help: Link type buttons cannot execute commands; they are only for redirecting users.
embeds.manager.empty_desc: Choose a message from the library on the left to start customizing it.
embeds.manager.missing_desc: No informative content was detected for this module. Configure texts in the editing panel.
guide.title: Contextual Guide
guide.empty: Nothing to report for this module, everything seems configured correctly!
guide.pro_tip_desc: Configure logs for each module to have full control over what happens in the server.
guide.whitelist.mode.title: Entry Mode
guide.whitelist.mode.hybrid: You set Hybrid mode: it's the pro choice. The user first sweats through the written test and then staff does the oral to be 100% sure.
guide.whitelist.mode.voice: Voice only? Get ready to spend your evenings talking! Joiners just click a button and wait for staff to call them.
guide.whitelist.mode.text: Simple and clean: the user answers questions and staff decides if it's okay. Great for high-traffic servers.
guide.whitelist.cooldown.title: Failure Cooldown
guide.whitelist.cooldown.text: Be careful, with a {cooldown}-hour block you're very tough! If someone fails the test they'll be out of the server for a while.
guide.whitelist.staff.title: Staff Roles
guide.whitelist.staff.text: Hey! You haven't set any staff roles. If you don't do it, no one will be able to accept or reject requests!
guide.verify.type.title: Verification Type
guide.verify.type.text: Verification is used to keep bots from breaking your server. 'Button' is the fastest, but 'Code' is the one that annoys bad bots the most.
guide.verify.role.title: Role to Give
guide.verify.role.text: You haven't chosen the role to assign! Without this, the user clicks but remains a ghost without permissions.
guide.tickets.panic.title: Panic Mode
guide.tickets.panic.text: PANIC ACTIVATED! No one can open tickets now. Use it only if the server is on fire or if the staff is all asleep.
guide.tickets.naming.title: Ticket Naming
guide.tickets.naming.text: Use clear names like 'ticket-{user}'. If you call them all the same, staff will go crazy trying to figure out whose is what.
guide.global.master.title: Master Permissions
guide.global.master.text: You set several admin roles. Remember these users can change EVERYTHING, even break the bot if they don't know what they're touching!
guide.global.logs.title: Logging Fallback
guide.global.logs.text: You enabled logs but didn't set a fallback channel. If a module doesn't have a dedicated log, it will write here.
guide.welcome.msg.title: Welcome Message
guide.welcome.msg.text: Don't forget to use {user} in the message! If you don't, it will seem cold and automatic.
guide.welcome.embed.title: Embed vs Text
guide.welcome.embed.text: Embeds are much cooler and professional, but remember to set a nice color so it doesn't appear dull.
guide.fivem.multi.title: Multi-Server
guide.fivem.multi.text: Managing multiple servers? Great! Just remember not to use the same channel for everyone's logs, or it will become a mess.
guide.photocontest.interval.title: Contest Interval
guide.photocontest.interval.text: Uh, contest every {interval} hours? You'll stress them out! Maybe extend the time a bit to build anticipation.
guide.photocontest.hall.title: Hall of Fame
guide.photocontest.hall.text: You haven't set a Hall of Fame channel. It's a shame; winners' photos should be showcased!
guide.photocontest.rewards.title: Automatic Rewards
guide.photocontest.rewards.text: Photo Contest is the best way to keep the server active. Remember you can force start a contest anytime with the button above!
guide.autoclear.noslot.title: No Slots
guide.autoclear.noslot.text: You haven't added any slots yet! Click 'Add Slot' to start automatically cleaning your channels.
guide.autoclear.freq.title: Very High Frequency
guide.autoclear.freq.text: You've set a slot with a frequency lower than 10 minutes. The bot will clean the channel very often; make sure that's what you want.
guide.moderation.active.title: Active Protection
guide.moderation.active.text: The system is active! Remember to configure anti-spam limits not to be too punitive with normal users.
guide.moderation.cooldown.title: Cooldown Warning
guide.moderation.cooldown.text: I've set a 10-second cooldown for bot warning messages: this way we avoid the bot itself spamming!
guide.moderation.punish.title: Progressive Punishments
guide.moderation.punish.text: You have few punishments configured. A good system has at least 3 levels: Warn, Timeout and then Ban.
guide.socials.webhook.title: Webhook Configuration
guide.socials.webhook.text: For Instagram, TikTok and Twitter you must use a service like IFTTT. Copy the link found in the 'Settings' tab of the chosen social network.
guide.socials.mention.title: Mention Everyone
guide.socials.mention.text: You've enabled @everyone ping on some social networks. Careful; if you post a lot, users might get annoyed by too many notifications!
guide.voice.join.title: Join Channel
guide.voice.join.text: You haven't set a join channel! Without that, the bot doesn't know where to 'listen' for users wanting an interview.
guide.voice.staff.title: Staff Roles
guide.voice.staff.text: Staff roles are missing. Remember only those with these roles can see commands to move people from queues.
guide.management.search.title: User Search
guide.management.search.text: Enter the user's Discord ID to see their full history: how many times they tried the test and if they have active cooldowns.
guide.management.reset.title: Total Reset
guide.management.reset.text: The red 'Reset State' button erases EVERYTHING. Use it only if you want to give a user a complete second chance.
guide.system.maintenance.title: Maintenance
guide.system.maintenance.text: From here you can check the health of the processes. If you see red errors, try restarting the specific module.
guide.giveaway.live.title: Live Management
guide.giveaway.live.text: You can manage participants directly from the Discord message by clicking on the embed buttons.
guide.giveaway.sched.title: Scheduling
guide.giveaway.sched.text: Scheduled giveaways start automatically at the exact established minute. Make sure the time is correct!
guide.giveaway.vis.title: Channel Visibility
guide.giveaway.vis.text: Only Text and Announcement channels are shown. If a channel doesn't appear, verify the bot has read permissions.
